newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank raises deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank raises deposit rates.

text.p: Thai Military Bank Plc said on Tuesday it raised interest rates on some fixed deposits by up to 50 basis points with immediate effect.
The interest rate on three-month fixed deposits between one and 10 million baht ($40,000-$400,000) was raised to 9.75 percent from 9.50 percent, the bank said in a statement.

The interest rates on three-month fixed deposits totalling between 10 million and 20 million baht were raised 25 basis points to 10.25 percent. The three-month fixed deposits for amounts over 20 million baht was increased to 10.75 percent from 10.25 percent previously.
The bank's interest rates offered to savings accounts and six and 12-month fixed deposits remained unchanged, the bank said. ($1 = 25 baht)
